page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.s6 family. It is equipped with 8 vCPUs and 8 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance utilizes a shared CPU allocation model under the KVM hypervisor, which can introduce resource contention depending on neighbor workloads. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external network-attached block storage. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to the shared CPU architecture and lack of local storage, this instance is positioned as a cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require dedicated CPU performance or high-speed local disk access. It is suitable for general-purpose applications, development environments, web serving, and lightweight database tasks that can tolerate shared resource environments.
